 Embark on a treasure hunt with us!
 Begin your quest !
 Our four Treasure Hunts
 1712. Rumour has it that a place has been erased from the maps: a legendary land called Eldoria, said to harbour a vast treasure within its borders.
The pirate Edward Kenway devoted his life to searching for the treasure, but never succeeded. However, he left behind a map, a parchment and some mysteriously coded letters, leading to the booty: a crystal skull set with a fire opal, and a chest full of gold coins.
To mark the release of Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced, discover this unique treasure hunt launched in partnership with Ubisoft, set against the backdrop of the Golden Age of Piracy.
 Discover 
 A unique Holy Grailed-themed treasure hunt with one goal: to uncover the legendary Exkalibur. Solve the 12 riddles to win the gold sword set with a 6.23-carat red spinel, worth €250,000.
Created in collaboration with Puy du Fou, the most awarded theme park in the world.
 Discover 
 A treasure hunt blending wine and alchemy. Track down the legendary elixir of long life to uncover the secret of immortality — and win a cellar of 3,600 prestigious French wines.
Created with 43 French wine estates and the Château de Vaux-le-Vicomte.
 Discover 
 In 1859, explorer Henri Mouhot discovers a golden Naga statue set with a ruby in the ruins of Angkor. He hides it and encodes its location through 8 riddles in his journal.
This charity treasure hunt, created for the benefit of Enfants du Mékong, was solved after 9 months of investigation, with the winners receiving the statue and a trip for two to Cambodia.
 I become a Treasure Hunter 
 Our DNA
 Our mission is to create ambitious treasure hunts that celebrate culture and history. Scrolls, treasure maps, illustrations, illuminated manuscripts… our games use a wide variety of materials and themes, designed as true intellectual challenges to be tackled with friends or family.
Your goal is always the same:

 Découvre la chasse au trésor avec nous !
 Ils parlent de nous
 Je deviens chasseur de trésor
 Découvrez nos 4 chasses
 1712. D'après les rumeurs, un lieu aurait été évincé des cartes. Un lieu légendaire, Eldoria, qui abriterait en son sein un immense trèsor.
Le pirate Edward Kenway a consacré sa vie à chercher le trésor, sans jamais y parvenir. Mais il a laissé derrière lui une carte, un parchemin, et des lettres mystérieusement chiffrées, menant vers le butin : un crâne de cristal, serti d'une opale de feu, ainsi qu'un coffre remplit de pièces d'or.
A l'occasion de la sortie d'Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, découvrez cette chasse unique lancée avec Ubisoft sur l'Âge d'Or de la piraterie.
 Découvrir
